description: Header file defining the MediaCodecsXmlParser class for parsing media codecs XML data in Android. Contains class declarations, data structures, and method signatures related to XML parsing of media codec information.

classes.name: MediaCodecsXmlParser
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing media codecs XML files and providing access to codec, role, and attribute data.

methods.name: getDefaultSearchDirs
methods.description: Returns default directories to search for XML files containing media codec info.

methods.name: getDefaultXmlNames
methods.description: Returns default XML filenames to parse.

methods.name: getParsingStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the XML parsing process.

methods.name: parseXmlFilesInSearchDirs
methods.description: Parses XML files from specified search directories.

methods.name: parseXmlPath
methods.description: Parses a specific XML file given its path.
